text:
: ★☆☆☆☆

I recently had the displeasure of dining at McDonald's in Edinburgh, and I must say that my experience was nothing short of a complete disappointment. From the slow and inefficient service to the abysmal quality of the food, my visit left me feeling utterly unsatisfied.

First and foremost, the service at this particular McDonald's was excruciatingly slow. Despite the relatively small number of customers, it seemed as though the staff were moving in slow motion. It took an unreasonably long time for my order to be taken, and even longer for it to be prepared and brought to my table. The lack of urgency and attentiveness was quite frustrating, especially considering the reputation of fast food establishments.

When my order finally arrived, I was immediately taken aback by the dismal quality of the food. The burgers were cold, as if they had been sitting out for an extended period of time before being served. The patties were overcooked and resembled charred hockey pucks, lacking any semblance of juiciness or flavor. It was clear that attention to detail and basic quality control were sorely lacking in the kitchen.

To add insult to injury, my burgers were completely devoid of any sauce. Not only did this significantly detract from the taste, but it also left me questioning the competence of the kitchen staff. How can a restaurant as renowned as McDonald's overlook such a basic element of their signature burgers? It was a glaring oversight that further contributed to my disappointment.

The chips, or rather, the sorry excuse for chips, were another letdown. They were clearly old and tasted stale. The once-crisp exterior had been replaced by a sad and limp texture, leaving me with a distinct feeling that I was eating a hollow shell of what should have been a satisfying side dish. It was a far cry from the hot and crispy chips one would expect from a fast food establishment.

Overall, my experience at McDonald's Edinburgh was a colossal letdown. The slow service, coupled with the cold, burnt burgers and the absence of sauce, left me with a strong sense of dissatisfaction. The sad excuse for chips further added to my disappointment. It's disheartening to witness such a renowned fast food chain fail so miserably in delivering the quality and service they are known for. Needless to say, I will not be returning to this particular McDonald's anytime soon.

Ps atleast serve some Tomato sauce or clean the trash cans!!
author: CJ Coetzee

I am fed up with how it's almost impossible it is to actually get this sorted, offering me a free meal DOES NOT make up for my missing fries, at this point I am unlikely to ever order from here again.
